categories.main_business_segments: The company is a precision structural components manufacturer and developer. Its primary business segments include: (1) Smart phone components - lens barrels, camera module shields, camera module carriers, motor brackets, and OIS motor supports; (2) Non-smartphone components - wearable devices (smart watch antennas, earphone shells, VR eyepiece barrels), smart home security (optical transparent components, threaded lens barrels, lens seats), automotive electronics (lens barrels, lens seats, housings, brackets), and other applications (notebook heat dissipation elements, drone lens barrels). The company also provides mold design, manufacturing, and maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include: (1) Precision mold design and manufacturing with capabilities in complex mold structures, featuring over 2,000 mold design parameters for smartphone optics; (2) Advanced manufacturing processes including injection molding, stamping, Insert Molding (IM), and hardening techniques; (3) IMMT (Insert Molding & Mounting Technology) - a proprietary technology for embedding and mounting components; (4) Automation and intelligent manufacturing systems including CNC machining centers, automated inspection systems, and smart production lines; (5) Precision machining capabilities achieving tolerances of ±1 micrometer and surface roughness of Rz0.1.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading global enterprises across multiple industries. Primary customers include: Sunny Optical (舜宇光学), Amphenol (安费诺), Samsung Electro-Mechanics (三星电机), TDK Corporation, Hikvision (海康威视), Dahua Technology (大华股份), and Crystal Optech (水晶光电). The company's products are primarily used in: (1) Smartphone optics and imaging modules; (2) Wearable devices including smartwatches and earbuds; (3) Smart home security and surveillance systems; (4) Automotive electronics and ADAS systems; (5) Other consumer electronics applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main manufacturing facilities located in Yuyao, Zhejiang Province. The company has established a significant domestic presence serving customers throughout China. In 2023, domestic sales accounted for 91.81% of total revenue (349.3 million yuan), while export sales represented 8.19% (31.2 million yuan), indicating the company is expanding its international presence with growing export business, particularly to overseas customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It functions as a precision component manufacturer and supplier to major original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and system integrators in the consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial sectors. The company sources raw materials (primarily plastic resins) from suppliers, manufactures precision structural components through advanced processes, and delivers finished products directly to customers. The company outsources only specific non-core activities such as electroplating and certain mold component manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) Deepening relationships with existing major customers while expanding into new customer segments; (2) Advancing precision manufacturing capabilities through automation and intelligent manufacturing systems; (3) Developing next-generation products including IMMT technology, periscope-style motor components, and OIS motor supports; (4) Expanding into adjacent markets including wearable devices, automotive electronics, and smart home security; (5) Continuous innovation in mold design, manufacturing processes, and quality control; (6) Building a research and development center to enhance innovation capacity; (7) Pursuing strategic expansion through capacity building and new production facilities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of precision structural components to major customers. The revenue model includes: (1) Product sales of precision structural components (97.95% of revenue) - sold directly to customers based on purchase orders and contracts; (2) Mold design, manufacturing, and maintenance services (included in main revenue); (3) Other business revenue (2.05%) including miscellaneous services. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with customers typically specifying materials and technical requirements. Payment terms are negotiated individually with customers, and the company recognizes revenue when customers take control of the products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the precision structural components manufacturing industry, which is characterized by high technical barriers and significant capital requirements. Key competitors include both domestic and international manufacturers of precision components. The company's competitive position is strengthened by: (1) Long-term relationships with industry-leading customers including Sunny Optical and Amphenol; (2) Recognition as a National-level 'Little Giant' enterprise by China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology; (3) Multiple awards from the China Mold Industry Association; (4) Designation as a Zhejiang Provincial Enterprise Technology Center; (5) High market concentration among leading customers, creating barriers to entry for competitors. The company maintains a strong market position through superior technical capabilities, product quality, and customer service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized precision manufacturing enterprise with significant growth trajectory. In 2023: Total revenue was 380.5 million yuan (up 8.75% from 349.9 million yuan in 2022); Net profit attributable to shareholders was 58.1 million yuan (down 4.09% from 60.6 million yuan in 2022); Total assets reached 823.5 million yuan (up 17.03% from 703.7 million yuan in 2022); Shareholders' equity was 399.9 million yuan (up 16.99% from 341.8 million yuan in 2022). The company completed its IPO in January 2024, raising capital for expansion. The company demonstrates consistent profitability with net profit margins around 15%, and is in a growth phase with expanding production capacity and market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on: (1) Ultra-high precision manufacturing - achieving ±1 micrometer tolerances and advanced surface finishes that enable superior optical and functional performance; (2) Advanced technology integration - combining precision molding with embedded electronics and automated assembly; (3) Rapid innovation and customization - ability to develop and deliver custom solutions quickly, from design to production in as little as 10 days; (4) Comprehensive technical support - deep collaboration with customers during product development and optimization; (5) Reliable quality and consistency - ISO9001 and IATF16949 certified processes ensuring stable, high-quality production at scale; (6) Cost-effective solutions - leveraging manufacturing scale and process optimization to deliver high-value components at competitive prices; (7) Integrated capabilities - combining mold design, precision manufacturing, automation, and quality control in a single supplier, reducing customer supply chain complexity.
